336:t_104:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't think I can't shoot you just because we used to be comrades! Just so you know, I don't have the slightest intention of forgiving you or that bastard $$バルビエル$$!」

336:t_105:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$揺れる天秤$$! I've been waiting for you to come!」

336:t_105:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks for the warm welcome. If I was going to be hit with a shocking truth like that, I'd have been better off not coming back.」

336:t_105:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That won't do! That one has been waiting, wanting to see you!」

336:t_105:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That's why I won't take your life...! I'll let you live, at the bare minimum!」

336:t_105:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Unbelievable. Can you really afford to say something like that?」

336:t_105:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If you want to enjoy a fight, give it everything you've got! Half-hearted won't make you a match for me!」

336:t_105:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Well said! It seems you are a warrior worthy of being my rival!」

336:t_105:9.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No thanks to that title, too! I fight strictly for peace, freedom, and paying off my debt!」

336:t_106:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Chief and $$エスター$$ sure are cold. I called to say I was coming back, so you'd think they could at least come out to greet me...)

336:t_106:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Well... if they'd announced a 1,000,000 G debt with a gong and a triangle sound effect, even I might not have been able to recover...!)
